test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given bar-graph and answer the question that follows.

The bar-graph represents the voting for class monitor in class 9.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a085cbc1b91c4f0ec33eafd2c829c15dcd75fe7907c3cf04d2bcba7482cbc62.png] 

In percentage figures how many more votes did Vaibhav get than Paridhi?
solution:
**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Difference of votes of paridhi and vaibhav = 20 - 16 = 4

Now Percentage,

⇒ (4/16) × 100

⇒ 1/4 × 100 = 25%

**∴ Vaibhav got 25% votes more than Paridhi.**
